The story follows a clear, logical chronological progression spanning a full academic year (from October to the following October). Every scene, piece of dialogue, and detail serves the central narrative and thematic focus: the contrast between institutional bureaucracy (represented by euphemistic language like "localized moisture condition" and "microbial growth") and the lived reality of the people inside the failing building. Recurring motifs—such as the blue-bird saucer, the smell of wet pennies, the displaced books, and the rain—bind the beginning, middle, and end together into a cohesive, quietly resonant whole.
